scope: One existing Raising state owns the shared calendar and durable elapsed precision. Pure clock transitions do not apply growth, hunger, disease, movement, training, lifespan or evolution effects.

clockWord.meaning: minutes within the current calendar year; not elapsed units

elapsedRemainder.meaning: raw timer-converted elapsed units; active scene selects the divisor without rescaling stored remainder

trainingDivisor.meaning: Training entry writes base divisor 400 shifted right once; exit restores 400

newGame.meaning: ROM default clock initialization; separate full New Game UI handler and initial creature selection remain partial.

yearMaximum.behavior: saturate year while calendar continues wrapping

endDay.meaning: entry stops clock and clears elapsed remainder; update advances to next day at 07:00

authority.sessionAdapter: createChampionshipR2Session.advanceRaisingClock delegates through the existing save coordinator to runtime.advanceClock

state.year: integer 0..99, or null when historical year is unknown
state.season: integer 0..3, or null when legacy date is unknown
state.dayOfSeason: integer 0..7, or null when legacy date is unknown
state.clockUnits: integer 0..399; RAW timer-converted remainder, never normalized. Training consumes /200; base helper consumes /400. A pure helper can consume saved remainder 300 with divisor 200 on its next nonzero update; this synthetic boundary case does not claim original Training entry preserves 300. Verified original entry/exit stop paths clear the raw accumulator.
state.clockSubunits: integer 0..999; browser precision with 1000 subunits per elapsed unit, explicitly engineering data rather than a recovered ROM field
state.clockRevision: monotonic safe integer bounded by state revision; one scalar instead of growing accepted command IDs

transition.api: runtime.advanceClock({ units, subunits = 0, divisor = 400, clearElapsed = false, expectedClockRevision })
transition.input: non-negative safe-integer raw units, optional integer subunits 0..999, optional verified divisor 200 or 400, and optional strict boolean clearElapsed; exact input keys; no implicit unit scaling
transition.zeroDelta: same snapshot unless an explicit verified clearElapsed stop clears a nonzero accumulator; no publication, revision, command-ID consumption or dirty transition when nothing changes
transition.clearElapsed: Atomically clears clockUnits and clockSubunits after a nonzero advance, or on its own for a verified stop. Zero delta never divides inherited remainder or advances a minute. An already-empty stop is a no-op. Paused time rejects positive elapsed advancement but permits a zero-delta accumulator clear.
transition.duplicateOrStale: expectedClockRevision mismatch rejects without state mutation
transition.observerReentry: rejected while current publication is notifying
transition.sideEffects: calendar and its two revisions only; residents, tick, feedback, eventLog, inventory and individual identity are unchanged
transition.cost: arithmetic rollover; constant-size sequence storage; coordinator hashes on save/status reads rather than every clock update

elapsedAndModeBoundary.pureHelper: advanceWorldClockUnits performs full arithmetic cascade without deciding whether natural time is allowed
elapsedAndModeBoundary.appResponsibility: Consume the verified timing/mode contract from the existing stage; reset elapsed baselines at session and visibility/context boundaries; do not replay background or offline time by assumption
elapsedAndModeBoundary.dayEnd: Natural writer checks 22:00 after advancement, then stops, clears the raw remainder and raises a day-end flag. Advance plus clearElapsed is one publication. A web safety clamp is not claimed to be the original arithmetic. Do not automatically apply untraced day-end resident writers.
elapsedAndModeBoundary.legacyApproximation: worldMinutesForRealSeconds and its historical 600-second assumption are not authorized sources for natural runtime time

browserAdapter.ticker: One callback on the existing Pixi Application ticker; no timer/RAF/bootstrap
browserAdapter.enabledContext: Visible normal RAISING_HOME only, without an open toolbar submenu or context loss
browserAdapter.unresolvedContexts: Other modes and modal contexts are gated off pending handler traces; this is incomplete integration, not a claim that all original scenes pause
browserAdapter.knownStop: Natural update reaching 22:00 and Training/Shop transitions clear domain raw remainder atomically
browserAdapter.background: Inactive/title/hidden/context-lost/replaced-session/long-gap resets elapsed sampling; no offline accrual
browserAdapter.savedPrecision: All raw units/subunits accepted into the domain are saved; incomplete virtual-frame phase under one native frame is measurement state, discarded when a new elapsed baseline is established
browserAdapter.manualOnly: main pagehide and visibility handlers never write a player save

persistence.documentDigestDomain: save-document-v2 retained for the existing serialized-document boundary

versions.1: Validate the exact unsigned v1 shape, add paused=false as the existing migration, then migrate to v4. Historical season/day/year remain null.
versions.2: Validate exact historical payload and raising-payload-v2 digest before migration. Historical season/day/year remain null.
versions.3: Validate exact historical payload and raising-payload-v3 digest before migration. Preserve season/day/minutes; year remains null.
versions.4: Require all precision fields and exact allowlist; validate raising-payload-v4 digest; preserve fractions and year knowledge on restore.

persistence.legacyPrecision: clockUnits=0 and clockSubunits=0 because previous saves could only represent whole minutes; this does not reconstruct lost elapsed time. Divisor is not persisted: the active verified scene contract selects it.
persistence.manualSave: No automatic checkpoint added by a clock publication
persistence.limits: Existing bounded plain-data, byte, depth, field and resident validation remain in force

remainingUnknowns: Any mode or modal clock rule not yet closed in the companion trace
